events.title: Nextfest Update
events.summary: Everise is participating in October Nextfest. We've updated the demo for the occasion, if you've already played before here's a list of everything that is new: Boss Rooms: Locked doors may now appear during your exploration. Behind those doors are special themed rooms, each with a special enemy waiting for you. Those rooms can be more challenging than regular rooms, but they may contain unique rewards. Make sure you always have a key with you if you plan to access them tho! Daily Modifiers: Each

events.title: Everise Demo is out now!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We're excited to announce that the Everise demo is now out and playable, just in time for the Medieval Fest! Thanks for all your support during the playtest, we were able to squash several bugs and improve the early game experience. During playtest we also noticing an influx of players from China, after a quick investigation we found out that some Chinese content creartors had uploaded videos of therri playthrough.
